claim_one_line: P-TWOENDED (value-probing wave, a STRUCTURE question): does the Kashaev tower's arithmetic carry the spherical Q(sqrt5)/E8 second end, or only the hyperbolic Q(sqrt-3)/E6 end? PRECISION-FLOOR (undecided, leaning single-end). PART A (cheap, C3 analysed cold, own-bench re-verified): C3's new factor of 5 (den 2^7*3^9*5) -- 724351 = 53x79x173 (three distinct unrelated primes, none shared with C1/C2 numerators, no phi/sqrt5 structure); the 5 tested against L(2,chi5), zeta_K(2), 1/phi^k, sqrt5/pi^2 etc -- NO clean sqrt5 fingerprint. The 5 is EQUALLY consistent with generic von Staudt-Clausen denominator growth (the Bernoulli/zeta mechanism that introduces primes) and with a genuine E8/sqrt5 signal -- a SINGLE data point cannot distinguish; the structure (unrelated primes) leans GENERIC/single-end. PART B (the definitive test): C4/C5 needed to >=18 trusted digits to factor their denominators and see if the 5 grows/recurs or sqrt5 appears in an odd coefficient; the tower was pushed toward N=70M but C4/C5 reached 0 trusted digits at tractable precision -- PRECISION-FLOOR. The N=70M extension was STOPPED at ~1hr (banking-seat resource call: disproportionate compute for a nice-to-have structure question whose cheap analysis already leans single-end). VERDICT: two-endedness UNDECIDED, leaning single-end (Q(sqrt-3) only); the C3 factor-of-5 most likely a generic artifact, not the E8 end. Reopenable only by a much larger tower (N >> 70M). Gate 5 untouched.
